items.title: Personas, Velvet Room and Shuffle Time
items.body: Persona Compendium from a lorebook (card, chat or global), fusion in the Velvet Room, Shuffle Time cards after won fights.

items.title: Confidants, Calendar and the Otherworld
items.body: Confidants with battle abilities, a calendar with times of day and deadlines, labyrinths and domains kept in the chat.

items.title: Together mode with format-heavy cards
items.body: Without the Info Box, Present Characters and Quests, the JSON block is asked for up front again and the last one is shown to the AI; the tracker block has the last word on the reply's format; a reply that still comes back without it gets its trackers from a separate call (Rescue missing trackers, on by default).
